title: Model Creation and Conversion
summary: This module handles the creation, conversion, and quantization of various model formats (like Safetensors, GGUF, and image generation models) into the system's internal representation, including applying adapters and configuring metadata.

nodes.label: Raw Model Files
nodes.title: Raw Model Files
nodes.description: Source model files in various formats (Safetensors, GGUF, Diffusers directories).

nodes.label: User Modelfile
nodes.title: User Modelfile
nodes.description: User-defined instructions for model creation, including source, templates, and parameters.

nodes.label: API Create Request
nodes.title: API Create Request
nodes.description: JSON payload containing model creation parameters via the API.

nodes.label: Handle Model Creation Request
nodes.title: Server.CreateHandler
nodes.description: Receives and orchestrates model creation requests, managing the overall workflow from input to output. (`server.create.Server.CreateHandler`)

nodes.label: Detect Model File Type
nodes.title: DetectModelTypeFromFiles
nodes.description: Identifies the format of input model files (e.g., GGUF, Safetensors) to guide appropriate conversion. (`server.routes_create_test.TestDetectModelTypeFromFiles`)

nodes.label: Validate Input Paths & Config
nodes.title: Validate Paths & Config
nodes.description: Ensures model file paths are valid and checks for required configuration files like `config.json`. (`server.create_test.TestConvertFromSafetensors`, `x.create.client.create_test.TestCreateModel_NotSafetensorsDir`, `x.create.create_test.TestCreateSafetensorsModel_NoConfigJson`)

nodes.label: Convert Safetensors Model
nodes.title: Convert Safetensors
nodes.description: Processes and converts Safetensors formatted models, handling complex tensor transformations, packing, and specific model architectures like Qwen3.5 and Laguna. (`integration.create_test.TestCreateSafetensorsLLM`, `x.create.create_test.TestCreateSafetensorsModel*`, `x.create.laguna_test.TestCreateSafetensorsModel*`)

nodes.label: Convert GGUF Model
nodes.title: Convert GGUF
nodes.description: Converts GGUF formatted model files into the system's internal representation. (`integration.create_test.TestCreateGGUF`, `server.routes_create_test.TestCreateFromBin`)

nodes.label: Convert Image Generation Model
nodes.title: Convert ImageGen
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of image generation models, typically from Diffusers format. (`integration.create_imagegen_test.TestCreateImageGen`)

nodes.label: Apply Model Quantization
nodes.title: Quantize Model
nodes.description: Reduces the precision of model weights (e.g., F16 to Q4_K, HF FP8 to MXFP8/NVFP4) to optimize for size and performance. (`server.quantization_test.TestQuantizeModel`, `x.create.create_test.TestCreateSafetensorsModel_WithQuantize`)

nodes.label: Apply LoRA Adapters
nodes.title: Convert Adapter
nodes.description: Integrates LoRA adapter weights with a base model during the conversion process. (`convert.convert_test.TestConvertAdapter`)

nodes.label: Configure Model Metadata
nodes.title: Configure Metadata
nodes.description: Applies model-specific metadata such as renderer, parser, templates, and system prompts. (`server.routes_create_test.TestCreateNemotronHDefaultsRendererParser`, `server.routes_create_test.TestCreateTemplateSystem`, `server.routes_create_test.TestCreateDetectTemplate`)

nodes.label: Generate Model Manifest
nodes.title: Generate Manifest
nodes.description: Creates the final manifest file that describes the model's layers and configuration. (`x.create.create_test.TestCreateSafetensorsModel`)

nodes.label: Store Model Artifacts
nodes.title: Store Artifacts
nodes.description: Persists the converted model layers and manifest to storage. (`server.routes_create_test.TestCreateFromBin`, `server.routes_create_test.TestCreateTemplateSystem`)
